verdict.rationale: Terraform provides its own review-gate building blocks. `terraform plan` previews changes, and `-out` saves a plan that `apply` later executes. `apply` interactively prompts for approval unless `-auto-approve` is passed. HCP Terraform policy enforcement validates plans against rules, with results viewable and overridable in the workspace UI. Least-privilege credential scoping for an agent and agent-specific approval workflows are not evidenced. missing for 10: documented least-privilege/scoped credentials for agent-run plans and applies, an explicit agent-oriented approval gate that blocks unapproved applies, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent-gated workflow
